summary: Master Applied Econometrics for Macro-Economics and Finance. Join our course to enhance your analytical skills and understand economic trends.
lede: Applied Econometrics for Macro-Economics and Finance helps analysts turn economic and financial data into evidence they can explain, reproduce, and defend. The course covers OLS, time-series diagnostics, ARIMA forecasting, VAR analysis, cointegration, and GARCH concepts while focusing on how each method fits a specific economic question. You will build a structured workflow for data preparation, model specification, hypothesis testing, diagnostics, forecast validation, and uncertainty communication. Practical outputs include forecast comparisons, diagnostic reports, scenario analysis, and a concise analytical briefing designed to support macroeconomic and financial decisions.
audienceIntro: Applied Econometrics Training suits professionals who already work with economic, financial, or business data and need stronger model selection and interpretation skills. It is designed for intermediate to advanced learners who can follow quantitative reasoning and want guided practice with realistic macroeconomic and financial datasets.
prerequisites: You should have a working knowledge of descriptive statistics, probability, regression concepts, and spreadsheet-based data analysis. Familiarity with economic indicators, financial returns, or forecasting improves the learning experience, but prior experience with time-series econometrics is not required. Coding is not required for completion, although basic R or Python familiarity will help you move faster during the practical labs. Advanced concepts such as VAR, VECM, and GARCH receive operational application depth, while AI-assisted forecasting and panel-data methods receive conceptual and guided analytical coverage rather than production-engineering depth.
